'''Eric Hunter''' (GEMP handle '''ototoi'''<ref name="kash23">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1399156#p1399156 2023 Kashyyyk players and event #1!], Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums (29 January 2023): &ldquo;Eric Hunter - ototoi&rdquo;</ref>; forum handle '''Wokling'''<ref name="seal22">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=77430 Sealed league signups], Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, post by Wokling (1 July 2022), signed &ldquo;Eric ototoi Wokling&rdquo;; [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/search.php?author_id=18372&sr=posts posts by Wokling]</ref>) is a member of [[Team 5]]<ref name="slack-2021">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Joe Olson (arebelspy), 14 January 2021</ref> and [[Hayes Hunter]]'s brother.<ref name="worlds24-wrap">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-worlds-wrap-up-joe-olson-earns-third-championship-win/ 2024 Worlds Wrap-Up - Joe Olson Earns Third Championship Win], starwarsccg.org: &ldquo;Hayes&rsquo; award was presented by his brother Eric Hunter&rdquo;</ref> He finished 4th at the [[2024 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-09-world-championships-bochum-germany-19-22-september-2024/ 2024 World Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref> He is credited with the original concept of the card Wokling (V), whose Virtual Set 3 slip also reads &ldquo;GenCon 2002 Winner&rdquo;.<ref name="wokcard">[[Wokling (V) (Virtual Set 3)]], slip 25 ([[:File:VS3O-25-Wokling.png]]): margin credits &ldquo;Original concept by Eric Hunter&rdquo; and &ldquo;GenCon 2002 Winner&rdquo;. The Virtual Set 0 version, [[Wokling (V)]] ([[:File:V0-L-wokling.gif]]), also carries &ldquo;Original concept by Eric Hunter&rdquo;.</ref>
